propositions: Introduce a rotation module that persists GET-rotation state to a new .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file while dual-writing the legacy inline field during rollout to maintain interleaved binary compatibility.
Load chronological max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) for each Jira key on read and persist every new timestamp to both sidecar and legacy inline field on every BindingStore.save() call.
Include get_rotation.json in explicit local staging and git commit paths without git add -A, and document it in push.py regenerable-files.

A pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD after rotation state is initialized; a pass with absent-key GETs advances rotation stamps in both files.
The outbound_differ module must remain at or below 800 lines after extracting existing outbound wrappers to support the rotation integration.
Interleaved old-binary and new-binary pass sequences produce identical rotation ordering, and legacy-only stores materialize equivalent sidecar state on next persisted save.
